tldr: UCP lets an agent discover what a store supports, agree on capabilities and run checkout, cart and orders over REST, MCP, A2A or embedded UI. The store stays merchant of record; payments use tokenized credentials.
whyItExists: Every agent surface that wants to buy from every store faces an N by N integration problem: each retailer has its own cart, checkout and payment APIs, and each agent platform has its own way to call them. UCP gives both sides one published profile and one set of capability schemas, so a platform can read a store's profile at /.well-known/ucp, agree on the features both support, and drive checkout without a custom integration. The store keeps the customer relationship, its own payment provider and its liability as merchant of record, and the platform passes it an opaque payment token that a wallet or credential provider issued.

whatItIsNot.text: Not Google's Universal Cart. Universal Cart is a Google shopping product, announced on 2026-05-19 and launched in the US on 2026-10-15, that uses UCP for checkout; UCP is the open protocol underneath.
Not a way for Google to become the seller. The business is the merchant of record and keeps financial liability and the order; Google is not the merchant of record.

Not the same thing as AP2. AP2 is an optional extension used inside UCP (dev.ucp.common.payment.ap2_mandate); UCP says where the AP2 signatures go, AP2 defines the mandate formats, and live use of AP2 mandates in UCP is unverified, although Google says Gemini uses AP2 for its Google Pay purchases outside any documented UCP flow.
Not a payment network or processor. The business's own payment service provider authorizes and settles; UCP carries an opaque credential from platform to business, one way only.
Not a foundation project. A Governing Council owns the assets, Google and Shopify hold permanent seats, and Google keeps proxy votes for open seats until December 2028 and custody of ucp.dev.

Not bridged to OpenAI's ACP. Both cover agent checkout with the merchant as merchant of record, but no mapping between the two is specified. OpenAI's plugin guide of 2026-11-13 shows a reference checkout that follows UCP's field names without naming either protocol.
Not an on-chain identity scheme. A platform is identified by its profile URL, its domain and the keys it publishes, not by a registry or a wallet address.

changedRecently.text: Google began rolling out grocery Connected Apps powered by UCP in the US through Search and the Gemini app, including Albertsons, Safeway, Shaw's and Target. Its grocery guide describes a sample integration that builds the cart over UCP, recommends MCP and hands checkout to the retailer through continue_url.
UCP opened nominations for three eight-week Regional Domain Working Groups (APAC, EMEA, LATAM), sponsored by the Shopping and Payments Tech Councils.

Google said Gemini now uses AP2 for its Google Pay purchases in Tasks and that integrating UCP into Gemini comes next; Google's UCP platform profiles declare no AP2 extension, and live use of the extension stays unverified.

ucp-schema 2.0.0 shipped with a breaking API change plus type and OpenAPI 3.1 generation; by 2026-11-19 both SDKs pinned it on main and set up spec-dated releases such as 20260825.0.0, none published yet.

The Governing Council approved nominations for founding Local Services and B2B Procurement Tech Councils (applications close 2026-11-27) and agreed to explore overlaps between UCP and PAP, which the atlas reads as the Personal Agent Protocol, to avoid fragmentation.
Sierra released Personal Agent Protocol 1.0, whose UCP extension, co-authored by Shopify, leaves the shopping to UCP and connects to Ask.
A draft Food Checkout capability, dev.ucp.food.checkout with fulfillment and tip extensions, merged on main and was announced on 2026-11-13; it is in no release.
Microsoft's Copilot Checkout page dropped its answer that Microsoft takes no commission today; the page now makes no fee statement, which is not evidence of a fee.

UCP direct checkout began rolling out to Canadian shoppers on AI Mode in Google Search and the Gemini app, with lululemon, select Shopify merchants, Shoppers Drug Mart and Simons; Universal Cart stays US-only.

By 2026-11-03 Shopify's help center opened Google direct checkout to stores based anywhere that sell to customers in the US, Canada or Australia. Google announced Canadian checkout; for Australia its Merchant Center help puts eligible products in scope, but no Google source says checkout there is live.

The Ask capability, dev.ucp.common.ask, was backported into the 2026-08-25 release branch (PR 1024) and ucp.dev serves it as 2026-08-25; Shopify said on 2026-11-06 that it is live across Shopify storefronts. The git tag does not include it.

Google's UCP network guide now gives Google-Shopping-Merchant-Integration as the default User-Agent, and its FAQ verifies Google's requests by mutual TLS, ES256 RFC 9421 signatures against the keys at ucp.goog and source ASN; reverse DNS is no longer offered.
The v2026-08-25 and v2026-04-08 tags were moved on 2026-10-22 or 2026-10-23 to include backports; v2026-04-08 now also carries permalink and Web Bot Auth interop.
A draft change (PR 659, in no release) requires webhook signatures to cover Webhook-Id and Webhook-Timestamp, keeps both on retries and has platforms deduplicate on Webhook-Id.
Universal Cart launched in the US across Google Search and the Gemini app with checkout powered by UCP; merchants remain the seller of record.

A contributing guide defined an Enhancement Proposal lifecycle and the maturity levels Working Draft, Candidate and Stable; Simon Farrow (Global Payments) replaced Harsh Mehta on the Payments Tech Council.
A draft lodging booking capability merged on main (PR 780) and was announced on 2026-09-25; it is not in any release.
Secondary reports date the automatic enrollment of eligible US Shopify stores in Google's direct checkout, on by default with an opt-out, to around 2026-09-22.
Google said UCP already enables direct checkout for hundreds of thousands of brands and retailers across Google, a marketing figure with no exact count or volume.
UCP had a session at the W3C and GS1 workshop on e-commerce for humans and AI agents.
A Payments Tech Council formed with Adyen, Ant International, Coinbase, Global Payments, Google, PayPal, Shopify and Stripe, after Food (2026-07-16) and Lodging (2026-08-11) councils.
Release v2026-08-25 added actions, 3DS2 through actions, split payments, Web Bot Auth interop and the keys[] array, and renamed the AP2 extension to dev.ucp.common.payment.ap2_mandate.
Google said UCP checkout would reach Canada and Australia in the coming months, then the UK, and come to Direct Offers and to Shopping ads on YouTube.
Google announced Universal Cart, a shopping product that uses UCP for checkout, and said AP2 would come to Google products in the coming months.
Stripe took a Governing Council seat, two more elected seats were added, and Google donated AP2 to the FIDO Alliance the same day.
The Shopping Tech Council grew to 16 seats with new members from Amazon, Meta, Microsoft, Stripe and Salesforce.
